approvalAuthority: Astro Fighters — Art Preview Review Rubric.md

canonical.movementDirections: eight-direction movement (normalized diagonals); the canonical direction list above names the movement directions and the eight reference frames

characterFacing.status: adopted by user 2026-10-12 (four-direction facing; replaces eight-direction facing)
characterFacing.rule: any horizontal movement or aim component sets facing E or W (NE and SE use E, NW and SW use W); pure vertical movement sets N or S; with no input the last facing holds; a diagonal keeps the current horizontal facing when it begins (no flicker on a brief tap)
characterFacing.attacks: attacks play and resolve in the current facing; the hit arc points along that facing (combo.json hitArea); each attack press with a selected target first turns the character to face it (the target's dominant axis: E/W when the horizontal offset is at least the vertical, otherwise N/S), so the target sits inside the hit arc's centre half (user 2026-10-12)
characterFacing.mirroring: W is E mirrored frame for frame (attacks) or half a cycle later (cycles)
characterFacing.referenceFrames: the locked 512x64 reference sheets keep all eight frames (S, SE, E, NE, N, NW, W, SW) unchanged; the rig, anchors and overlay registration stay valid for all eight; runtime animation sheets use the four facing rows only
characterFacing.retiredDiagonalWork: SE/SW and NE/NW animation views (walk, sprint, lightAttack, idle) are retired from runtime; their specs and sheets remain in git history

characterAnimationPlan.timing: one speed per animation (base fps below); per-frame holds added only on approved key poses
characterAnimationPlan.rootMotion: per-frame dx, dy in pixels for world movement; the sprite stays anchored at pivot [32,63]
characterAnimationPlan.directionOrder: four facing rows S, E, N, W for every animation; E authored first, W mirrored, then S and N
characterAnimationPlan.idle: breathing: torso, head and arms settle 1 px down and return; pelvis and legs fixed; downward-only moves need no new pixels
characterAnimationPlan.walk: contact, down, passing, up per step; the planted foot slides back in the frame exactly as far as the root motion carries the body, so it stays fixed on the ground
characterAnimationPlan.sprint: Naruto-style run: lean from stacked head/torso/pelvis offsets, arms swept back, long low stride
characterAnimationPlan.lightAttack: taijutsu jab/cross: guard, jab (active), recoil (chain window), cross (active); hitboxes and damage events on active frames
characterAnimationPlan.guard: unarmed combat idle (user 2026-10-12): the jab/cross guard, hands up, with a slight 1 px bob, looping at 6 fps; every attack clip returns to it and it holds while in combat; the normal idle returns after a few seconds with no attack
characterAnimationPlan.oneHandDualGuard: dual-wield dagger combat stance (approved by user 2026-10-13): a tanto in each hand, normal grip; main hand low at the hip, blade forward and raised 35 degrees; off hand raised, blade up; the guard idle motion (4 frames, 6 fps) with both daggers riding their hands; S matched to E by projection lines; N hands hidden in front of the body
characterAnimationPlan.oneHandGuard: one-handed weapon combat stance (approved by user 2026-10-13): wakizashi (default) or tanto in the near hand, low at the hip, blade forward and raised (wakizashi 10 degrees, tanto 35 degrees via itemPoses); free hand up in the guard; the guard idle motion (4 frames, 6 fps); S matched to E by projection lines; N hands hidden in front of the body
characterAnimationPlan.twoHandGuard: two-handed weapon combat stance (approved by user 2026-10-13): katana in chudan, both hands on the hilt in front of the navel, blade forward and up at 40 degrees; the guard idle motion (4 frames, 6 fps); S hands at the navel with the blade foreshortened up the centre line (projection lines); N katana drawn behind the body with its tip clearing the head beside the right shoulder
characterAnimationPlan.katanaLight: katana light chain (approved by user 2026-10-13, S, E, N, W): two vertical slashes, each one continuous swing - downCut 12 to 6 (raised wind-up in front of the face, one smear frame with the blade arriving low in line with the forearms, hold, return) and upCut 6 to 12 (low wind-up, one smear frame stopping in front of the face at about 1 o'clock, hold, return); chained from the low hold the upCut enters at its smear frame; S/N by projection lines (fists on the E rows, katana vertical foreshortened by |sin a|, smear as a vertical streak clipped to outside the silhouette in S, behind the body in N); next: twoHandGuard
characterAnimationPlan.katanaHeavy: katana heavy chain (approved by user 2026-10-13, S, E, N, W): two heavy side swings - sideCutR forehand from the right and sideCutL backhand from the left (finisher), each wind-up, coil, one smear frame, hold, recovery, return; swing angles authored in the horizontal plane and projected in the cabinet view (depth 0.5, far side up), elliptical smear with per-pixel depth; S/N re-projected from the same swing angles with lateral hand positions; the backhand enters at its smear frame from the forehand hold; combos in combo.json weapons.twoHanded; next: twoHandGuard
characterAnimationPlan.oneHandLight: one-handed light chain (approved by user 2026-10-13, S, E, N, W): three stabs with the main-hand weapon (wakizashi default, tanto option) while the off hand keeps its guard - stab1 chest, stab2 high, stab3 rising gut stab (finisher); each chamber, thrust (speed lines along the blade in E/W), hold, return to oneHandGuard; S/N by projection lines (the blade toward/away from the viewer is a short vertical, the body turns into each thrust; N hides the hand and blade in front of the body)
characterAnimationPlan.dualLight: dual-wield light chain (approved by user 2026-10-13, S, E, N, W): a tanto in each hand - stab1 main-hand chest stab, stab2 main-hand rising gut stab (chamber, thrust with speed lines in E/W, hold, return), offSlash off-hand 12-to-6 slash finisher from the raised guard (one smear frame ending in line with the forearm, hold, return; entered at its smear frame from stab2's hold); the other hand keeps its guard; S/N by projection lines
characterAnimationPlan.oneHandHeavy: one-handed heavy chain (approved by user 2026-10-13, S, E, N, W): two wide horizontal swipes with the main-hand weapon (wakizashi default, tanto option) while the off hand keeps its guard - swipeR forehand from the right and swipeL backhand from the left (finisher, entered at its smear frame from the forehand's hold); each wind-up, coil, one elliptical smear frame, hold, recovery, return; swing angles authored in the horizontal plane and projected per view (cabinet, depth 0.5); the body turns into each swipe in S/N; N shows the swinging arm from behind with the fist and dagger past the far side of the torso, draws a dagger only while its fist shows, and keeps blades over the holding arm (weapon depth aboveArm with the posed helper arm-weapon-mask.png)
characterAnimationPlan.dualHeavy: dual-wield heavy chain (approved by user 2026-10-13, S, E, N, W): a tanto in each hand - mainSwipe main-hand forehand from the right, offSwipe off-hand forehand from the left (finisher, entered at its coil frame from the main swipe's hold); the other hand keeps its guard; built as oneHandHeavy
characterAnimationPlan.weave: unarmed weave/dodge (approved by user 2026-10-14, S, E, N, W; approved as a weave from the first hit-recoil candidate): from the guard the head and shoulders slip back, the guard rises to cover the face and the body slides back 2 px then 1 px, then comes forward into the guard; frames 0-3 evade, 4-5 recovery; S/N by projection lines: the shoulders widen and the arms swing out as in E, the backward lean is the upper body moving as one rigid block (up in S, down in N) with the head on the torso; unarmed only for now (no weapon sheets)
characterAnimationPlan.hitReact: hit recoil, unarmed (approved by user: E/W 2026-10-14, S/N 2026-10-19): struck in the face from the guard - frame 0 impact (head snapped back past upright, hips forward, guard knocked down and out, knees give 2 px), frame 1 furthest point (arms limp), frame 2 stagger, frames 3-4 the head comes forward and the hands come back up, frames 5-6 the guard; eyes shut on frames 0-2 and a squint on 3 (expression in the eye layers); a subtle impact burst in its own layer impact-fx (frame 0 flash, frame 1 sparks); knockback 2 px then 1 px; hitstun 0-4, recover 5-6
characterAnimationPlan.exhausted: exhausted idle stance (approved by user 2026-10-14, S, E, N, W): the rest pose while a fighter has no stamina (combo.json stamina) - 6 frames, 6 fps loop from the guard: guard dropped (loose fists at waist height, in S hanging in front of the hips below the wrist wraps), head and shoulders sagging forward, knees bent low, heavy breathing (in-breath frames 0-2, out-breath 3-5), heavy-lidded eyes; it replaces the guard until stamina recovers (unarmed; weapon modes keep their stance until weapon variants exist)
characterAnimationPlan.block: block stance (approved by user 2026-10-14, S, E, N, W): a held high cover from the guard, a second defensive option next to the weave (user 2026-10-14: the player can block or try to time a weave; combo.json block: less stamina than a weave, a blocked hit still lands with less health damage and more poise damage) - both forearms upright in front of the face, fists at the nose, elbows in front of the chest, chin tucked, the guard bob while held
characterAnimationPlan.guardBreak: guard-break stagger (approved by user 2026-10-14, S, E, N, W): plays when poise runs out while blocking (combo.json poise) - 9 frames at 10 fps (0.9 s, longer than the hit recoil): the block blasted open (arms flung up and wide), rocked back (head back, hips forward; S/N a rigid 1 px upper-body tilt), body driven back 2, 1, 1 px, a wobble, then the hands back up into the guard; eyes shut 0-2 and a squint 3-4 (the hit recoil wince, E/W and S), burst 0 and sparks 1; stagger 0-6 (no input, open to hits), recover 7-8
characterAnimationPlan.heavyAttack: kick chain in three clips, one heavy press each, every clip starting and ending in the orthodox guard: low kick 5 (rear-leg lift, low kick with the shin at knee height, recoil, return); snap kick 5 (rear knee lift, chamber, snap at stomach height, rechamber, return); spin 3 (through the S, W and N pivot bodies) + rear-leg roundhouse at head height + fold + recovery (finisher); user redesign 2026-10-12
characterAnimationPlan.combo: production/source/characters/anim/male/combo.json: light attack key and heavy attack key; allowed combos only: light, light (jab, cross); light, light, heavy (jab, cross, spin roundhouse); light, heavy (jab, spin roundhouse); heavy, heavy, heavy (low kick, snap kick, spin roundhouse); kicks never lead into punches (user 2026-10-12); light, weave, heavy (jab, weave, spin roundhouse; the weave key in the jab's chain window, heavy in the weave's recovery frames; user 2026-10-14); lights are faster than heavies and a landed light interrupts a heavy; weaves cost stamina and a fighter with no stamina is exhausted (no sprint or dodge, slowed attacks) (combo.json attackSpeed, stamina; user 2026-10-14)
characterAnimationPlan.secondaryMotion: sash part sways; long hair split into cap / upper fall / lower fall with 1- and 2-frame lag
characterAnimationPlan.continuityRule: outfit and clothing elements (wrist and ankle wraps, garments, armour pieces, sash, hair, eyes) never disappear between stances or states: an element visible in one state stays visible in every other state wherever its body part shows; it may be hidden only by real occlusion (behind the body, a limb or a weapon), never by a fist, pose or construction that drops it (user 2026-10-14)
characterAnimationPlan.outlineRule: body-part outlines are kept for readability and layering: every limb drawn over the body or another limb (band arms and legs, bent forearms over upper arms, punches across the chest) keeps its own outline there, except where it joins its parent (shoulder, hip, elbow); user rule 2026-10-09

characterGeometry.policy: locked base geometry under change control (AGENTS.md)

skinToneReferences.role: colour authority only; not geometry, animation base, or runtime asset

tone2.derivation: light = tone2 mid + tone1 light-mid OKLab step; other steps from Body2 reference

characterGeometry.referencePoseRole: frame 0 of each direction's ready state
characterGeometry.skinVariants: palette maps of Body1 geometry to a target skin ramp
characterGeometry.animationBaseApproval: per state per direction; approved frames become locked production geometry
characterGeometry.riggingRule: cut-out rig from reference-pose pixels; whole-pixel moves and approved part variants/joint patches only; no rotation or resampling
characterGeometry.partSides: R/L are the character's anatomical sides; each rig frame records nearSide/farSide (null for S and N)

male.status: approved by user 2026-10-02; S/N legs and NE/NW feet regenerated after the Body1 update of 2026-10-06 — pending re-approval

maleOverlaySplit.status: approved by user 2026-10-02; armour belt split added after approval (candidate)

contactShadow.frames: same 23×5 ellipse in all eight frames, rows 59–63, centred on x≈32

characterGeometry.equipmentRule: rigid items placed by anchor; deformable items authored per body-part pose; runtime-eligible only with full direction × state × frame coverage
characterGeometry.generatedImageryRule: reference only; no production pixel converted from generated imagery
openIssues: reference-pose feet touch the frame bottom (y=63); no headroom below the contact line

activePackage.goal: Establish the first shared Imperial City surface/architecture kit and a fully dressed fighter benchmark that can be integrated together for the first rubric-scored production slice.

worldContract.gridRule: Module edges and repeated detail may not reveal the hidden 32×32 movement grid.

characterDependencies.drawOrderRule: Near/far garment panels route by canonical facing; no whole-overlay layer may cover anatomy that should remain visible.
validation: every animation base frame approved and locked
no production pixels converted from generated imagery

requiredBeforeRuntimeDerivation: animation base frames approved and locked for every contracted state and direction
dressed benchmark overlays approved for every contracted state and direction
modular character source assembly matches benchmark
